notes: Three routes split by «وحدثنيه» (after the saying «واحدة») and «ح» (before «وحدثناه»); «يعني ابن الحارث» after «خالد» is an editor's gloss and is left out; in the second route «وقال فيه حدثني معيقيب» is a variant wording of the same chain, not read as a link, so the route ends with «بهذا الإسناد» as a back_reference; needs_ruling because the variant may place «معيقيب» directly after «هشام»; «يحيى» in the third route is written bare and read as written
